Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely decided that “Prince Napoléon Bonaparte” referred to Napoleon I and pivoted the search to his father (Carlo Buonaparte), instead of properly disambiguating. They overlooked the well-known “Prince Napoléon” (Napoléon Joseph Charles Paul Bonaparte, 1822–1891), whose father is Jérôme Bonaparte—born 15 November 1784. This misidentification led the workflow down the wrong path and produced the wrong final answer.
